_comment: runtimeExecutable is a pyenv-installed python BINARY, deliberately, on macOS.
This repo sits under ~/Desktop, which macOS TCC protects. Claude.app already
holds the Desktop grant, but TCC attributes access per executable identity,
and two obvious choices do NOT inherit it:
/usr/bin/python3        -> resolves to Xcode's Python.app, a separate app
bundle with its own TCC identity. getcwd() and
every listdir under ~/Desktop return EPERM, so
it cannot read a single file in this repo.
~/.pyenv/shims/python3  -> a shell script; the shell fails getcwd first
A plain pyenv binary inherits the grant and works normally - verified by
listing every path component from / down to the repo.
If this version is ever removed, point it at any other
~/.pyenv/versions/<ver>/bin/python3. Do not 'simplify' it back to python3.
